title: Interrupts cancel stale narration and queued visual actions
problemCues: User stops speech or changes selection while assistant is acting
preconditions: Cancellable action queue and shared selection ids
decision: Stopping speech also cancels stale narration and queued visual actions where appropriate. Distinguish cancelled work from completed writes. Provisional targets: local stop ack p95 ≤300ms, audible stop p95 ≤500ms after baseline.
exceptions: Already-committed idempotent writes that must surface as completed with undo if available
source: roadmap Phase 3 exit gate; Sesame timing research as reference only
validatedBy: Scripted interrupt scenarios; no wrong-record mutation after cancel
